pricing.source: utility rate sheet, supplied by the account holder

excluded.note: Other bill riders, fees and taxes are not in these rates, and no fixed charge is included in any figure the site prints.

peak_window.note: On-peak is 5 p.m. to 9 p.m., Monday to Friday. The end hour is exclusive: 21:00 is off-peak again. Weekends are off-peak all day.

export_credit.note: Inferred from the utility's TOU advisory: energy generated during on-peak hours earns on-peak credits. The site therefore values an exported kWh at the price in force when it was exported — on-peak for weekday 5-9 p.m., off-peak at all other times under TOU, and the flat rate under the flat plan. Confirm with the utility: if credits are paid at a separate export rate, every net figure here changes.

assumptions.capture: every exported kWh, treated as daytime surplus
